description: This file contains pytest-based test cases for the 'handle_get_run_command' and 'create_minimal_project_config' functions within the 'universalinit.cli' module. It tests retrieval of project-specific run commands for various project types by mocking the involved classes and methods.

classes.name: MagicMock
classes.description: Mock class used for testing, simulating real objects and methods.

classes.name: patch
classes.description: Context manager for temporarily replacing modules or objects during testing.

methods.name: test_get_run_command(project_type, expected_run_command)
methods.description: Test function that verifies the 'handle_get_run_command' function's correct output across various project types by mocking dependencies and inspecting printed JSON output.
